newsitem.title: USA: Digi sees further cost savings in Q3, Q4.
newsitem.headline: Digi sees further cost savings in Q3, Q4.

text.p: Digi International Inc said it expects to reduce operating expenses again in the third and fourth quarters as a result of restructuring.
The company reported Thursday that operating expenses in the second fiscal quarter ended March 31 fell to $18.6 million from $21 million in the first fiscal quarter of 1997.
"Second quarter 1997 operating expenses do not yet reflect the benefit of ... headcount reductions as these actions occurred toward the end of the second quarter," said chief executive Jerry Dusa.
"Although we will achieve some operating expense reductions in the third quarter, we will not receive the full benefit of such actions until the fourth fiscal quarter of 1997," Dusa said.
The maker of computer hardware and software reported sales for the second quarter were $40.4 million, down 15.8 percent from $48.0 million for the same quarter in 1996.
Digi recorded a $9.4 million net loss in the quarter, compared to $4.6 million of net income a year ago.

The most recent results included a $1.6 million net loss on an investment in AetherWorks Corp, a development stage company in wireless and dial-up remote access technology, as well as a $10.5 million restructuring charge.
"We made progress in the restructuring actions we announced on February 13," Dusa said, noting that the company's workforce was cut by 21 percent to 565 employees through layoffs and attrition.
Shares in Digi were up 3/4 to 6.
